from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

# Change this to the real workbook location.
input_file = Path.home() / "Downloads" / "actual_workbook_name.xlsx"
output_file = Path.home() / "Downloads" / "confirmed_orders.txt"

# Change these if the Excel headings differ.
ORDER_COL = "Order Number"
STATUS_COL = "Status"
QUANTITY_COL = "Quantity"
SHEET_NAME = 0  # First worksheet, or specify a name such as "Orders"

expected = {
    "ORD-5B048F": 108,
    "ORD-542FDA": 68,
}

if not input_file.is_file():
    raise FileNotFoundError(
        f"Workbook not found: {input_file}\n"
        "Replace input_file with the workbook's exact path and filename."
    )

orders = pd.read_excel(input_file, sheet_name=SHEET_NAME)

order_ids = orders[ORDER_COL].astype(str).str.strip()
statuses = orders[STATUS_COL].astype(str).str.strip().str.casefold()
quantities = pd.to_numeric(orders[QUANTITY_COL], errors="coerce")

# Match both the order number and its expected quantity. Any cancelled row
# is explicitly excluded. Add statuses.eq("confirmed") if that exact status
# is required.
pair_matches = pd.Series(False, index=orders.index)
for order_id, expected_quantity in expected.items():
    pair_matches |= order_ids.eq(order_id) & quantities.eq(expected_quantity)

confirmed = orders[
    pair_matches & ~statuses.eq("cancelled")
][[ORDER_COL, QUANTITY_COL]]

confirmed.to_csv(output_file, sep="\t", index=False)

print(f"Saved {len(confirmed)} rows to: {output_file}")
print(confirmed.to_string(index=False))
